education_level.instructions: Use state.cv and state.question_args.education_level.scope. Choose the highest completed qualification within that scope as of state.reference_date. An empty scope means any field. Do not count ongoing or planned study, attendance without completion, or short training certificates as completed academic qualifications.

criteria.secondary_or_lower: A completed secondary-school qualification or lower, with no higher qualifying level within the scope.
criteria.vocational_technical: A completed upper-secondary or post-secondary vocational/technical qualification below higher education.
criteria.short_cycle_higher: A completed short-cycle higher-education qualification below bachelor's level, such as an associate degree, HND or foundation degree.
criteria.bachelors: A completed bachelor's degree or equivalent within the scope.
criteria.masters: A completed master's degree or equivalent within the scope.
criteria.doctorate: A completed doctorate or equivalent within the scope.
criteria.not_stated: No completed qualification within the scope is evidenced. Ongoing study alone does not establish completion.

certification.instructions: Use state.cv and state.question_args.certification. The name and aliases identify ONE credential, not alternative qualifications. skill_coverage.instructions: Use state.cv and state.question_args.skill_coverage.items.
